scope: Workspace-only render candidate and comparison; no radio writes or production source edits by this agent.

baseline.note: Canonical changed from earlier ROLL-DISPLAY f3ec before the workspace copy; baseline is1a14 with parent changes already present.

changes: 32-position FIFO cache retains each value cell’s last complete fit and unit baseline; invalidates on content, requested font, units, geometry, centering, LCD object or sizeText function changes; colors remain live.
Remove two literal array allocations from every Flight draw with equivalent two-step numeric loops.
Calculate the identical zero-horizon origin once for both strokes and caption exclusion checks.
comparisonCoverage: Exact ordered LCD command comparison of actual complete Flight renderers, not screenshots of a different implementation.
132 pitch/roll poses plus missing, numeric zero, long values, FrSky, units, font size, rectangle width/height, centering and live color changes.
Replacement lcd.sizeText function and LCD table; font APIs returning nil metrics; no TINSIZE fallback.
Eviction after100 unique positions and no font/fit work for the newest unchanged position; last-32 retention is explicit in candidate code.
Stable150-frame and moving150-frame sequences; changing pitch/roll/heading/speed/alt/current.

existingSuites.test_rendering.lua: Qualified IDs, bounded discovery retries, numeric units and binding art I/O checks pass per VM

limitations: Font API call counts are host measurements under matching LCD mocks; they are not physical radio FPS or native instruction-budget results.
The integrated result combines the candidate with the parent’s128-entry textWidth cache, so its improvement cannot be attributed entirely to the32-cell fit cache.
The cache stores only the current text at32 positions, not telemetry history.
Source validation, currentness, native attitude acquisition and raw values were not changed.
Parent owns integrated native benchmark and full-suite reports.
